newsitem.title: UK: Fitch affirms Louisiana Land & Exploration.
newsitem.headline: Fitch affirms Louisiana Land & Exploration.

text.p: The Louisiana Land and Exploration Co.'s (LL&E) BBB plus senior debt and its F2 commercial paper ratings were affirmed by Fitch Investors Service, the rating agency said on Tuesday.
"Additionally, the company's $300 million remaining under a Rule 415 shelf registration is affirmed BBB plus," Fitch said in a statement.
"After applying $70 million of asset sales proceeds for debt reduction, LL&E's pro forma debt at mid-year 1996 was $522 million.

"Affirmation is based on LL&E's strong cash flow generation, supported by rising volumes, ongoing unit cost reductions and comprehensive risk management to protect cash flows for the capital plan," the agency said.
With the August 1996 sale of its Mobile, AL. refinery, management exceeded, ahead of schedule, its $200 million debt reduction commitment following major acquisitions in 1993, Ftich said.
Fitch expects LL&E's creditor protection to strengthen further with stable to rising volumes and reasonable prices.

"LL&E has considerable financing flexibility to manage capital expenditures and has no scheduled maturities until 2001. LL&E should be able to grow reserves and production with strong levels of exploration and development spending from cash flows," it said.
